Nina (People Ops): Heads-up: new temporary 'family care support' for the upcoming company onsite (PDX/SF week, May 10-14). We know childcare/eldercare conflicts are a blocker for some folksso Redwood will reimburse ad-hoc care up to $125/day (max $500 for the week). Details below.
Carlos (Eng): Awesome 60a Any coverage for sudden daycare closures?
Nina (People Ops): Yes. Covers licensed drop-in centers, professional in-home care, and short-term caregiver hires booked specifically for onsite days. If your regular provider cancels and you hire backup so you can attend, that's eligible.
Ava (Sales): Does this apply to care for older relatives? My parents sometimes need help during travel weeks.
Nina (People Ops): Yes, eldercare support included under same cap. For family members who provide care (e.g., spouse/grandparent) we require a short attestation form; reimbursements for family caregivers are capped at $80/day for this pilot.
Finance Bot: Expense process: use code `POPS-FAM-2026`, tag "onsite-family-care". Attach itemized receipt + provider contact or signed attestation if family member. Fast-track approvals for May 10-14 dates.
Facilities Bot: Pre-vetted provider list: https://rwd.co/family-care-list. If you want confidential booking, choose the "private booking" option on the form.
Carlos (Eng): Contractors on 1099?
Finance Bot: Contractors & vendors are excluded in this pilot (company employees only). We'll report uptake and consider expansion next quarter.
Ava (Sales): Deadline to sign up?
Nina (People Ops): Quick form by Apr 30 -> https://rwd.co/famcare-pilot. We have funding for ~150 requests; priority to caregivers who must travel.
Carlos (Eng): Thanks, submitted.
Nina (People Ops): Follow-up: final FAQ + tax guidance will be emailed after enrollment closes. If you have an unusual case DM me (Nina).
